messages:
taylor: opened a PR to update Console observability docs — replace legacy trace header with W3C `traceparent` and update cost/latency widget metric keys. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/534

docs-bot: Pull request opened by @taylor — automated checks: linkcheck FAILED (1 outdated dashboard URL), lint queued.

pat: noted. examples still show `X-Cloud-Trace-Context` and old metric `token_cost`. Backend now expects `traceparent` and `token_unit_cost`. Also grouping key is `api_route` not `route`.

mei: I can update the SDK snippets. prefer per-request header injection so users attach traces to single calls. TS snippet I'll add:```ts
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-chat-7b', messages:[{role:'user',content:'hi'}], headers:{ traceparent: '00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01'} })
```

taylor: add a one-liner about sampling: "default hosted sampling = 1% — contact infra to increase". also include a troubleshooting note: "if traces don't appear check proxies aren't stripping `traceparent`."

pat: for the docs widget, include a minimal JSON fragment users can copy:```json
{"widget_type":"cost_breakdown","metrics":["token_unit_cost","latency_ms_p50"],"group_by":["api_route","model"],"time_range":"7d"}
```

docs-bot: linkcheck re-run: dashboard URL fixed by @mei. linter flagged a long line in the TS snippet.

mei: shortened the TS line and force-pushed. added sampling note and a short trace-id format line: "W3C traceparent -> version|trace-id(32 hex)|parent-id(16 hex)|flags" with link https://www.w3.org/TR/trace-context/

taylor: action items: (1) mei finalize Python + TS snippets and sampling/troubleshooting notes (2) pat add migration note mapping old->new keys (3) taylor quick editorial pass and merge once docs-bot green. target: EOD. :rocket:
